products.title: NatureMist Amla Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
NatureMist Amla Powder

Your botanical hair-care ritual, made simple.

Make wash day a moment of care with NatureMist Amla Powder. Prepare a fresh, mix-at-home hair mask and bring a botanical touch to your pre-wash routine.

From mixing your mask to taking a quiet moment before rinsing, this is an invitation to slow down and give your hair-care routine a little more attention. Add water gradually to create a paste with a consistency that works for you, preparing only what you need for each application.

A simple addition to your routine

  • Mix fresh each time: Prepare your hair mask when you are ready to use it.
  • Adjust the consistency: Add water gradually for a smooth, spreadable paste.
  • Make it your ritual: Include it as the mask step in your pre-wash hair-care routine.

How to use

Mix the powder with water in a clean bowl to make a smooth paste. Apply according to the directions on your product label, avoiding the eyes. Follow the label’s recommended application time, then rinse thoroughly. Prepare a fresh mixture for each use and discard any leftover wet paste.

Care and storage

Keep the container tightly closed in a cool, dry place, away from moisture and direct sunlight. Use a clean, dry spoon to scoop out the powder.

For external use only. Patch test before first use. Avoid inhaling the powder or applying it to irritated or broken skin. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.

NatureMist — Make time for your botanical ritual.

products.title: NatureMist Reetha Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
NatureMist Reetha Powder brings a traditional botanical cleansing step to your hair-care routine. Made in an easy-to-mix powder format, it can be prepared fresh with water and used as part of your wash-day ritual.

Reetha is widely used in traditional hair care for cleansing the scalp and hair while helping remove everyday oil and buildup. Its simple powder format lets you prepare only the amount you need for each use.

Why choose NatureMist Reetha Powder?

  • Traditional botanical hair and scalp cleansing powder
  • Helps remove oil and everyday buildup
  • Supports a refreshed scalp feel
  • Freshly prepared for each use
  • Easy addition to your wash-day ritual

How to use

Mix the required amount of powder with water to make a smooth paste. Apply to wet hair and scalp, massage gently, and rinse thoroughly with water. Avoid contact with eyes.

Care instructions

Store in a cool, dry place away from moisture. Keep the lid tightly closed after use.

Net Quantity: 250 g

products.title: NatureMist Indigo Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
A Traditional Botanical Hair-Colour Ritual

Discover a traditional approach to hair colouring with NatureMist Indigo Powder, made from finely powdered Indigofera tinctoria leaves.

Indigo is valued in botanical colour routines for adding cool, deep tones to hair. It is especially suited to two-step henna-and-indigo rituals where henna provides the warm base and Indigo is applied afterward to develop deeper brown-to-black-looking shades.

Unlike a cleansing or conditioning powder, Indigo should be treated as a colour ritual. The final shade depends on your starting hair colour, previous treatments, henna base, mixture, application time and individual hair.

Why choose NatureMist Indigo Powder?

  • Creates cool, deeper-looking botanical colour tones
  • Helps deepen the appearance of henna-coloured hair
  • Suitable for brown-to-dark botanical colour routines
  • Made from powdered Indigo leaves
  • Freshly mixed before every application
  • Allows colour intensity to be adjusted through your individual ritual

How to use

For deeper brown-to-black botanical colour routines, Indigo is commonly used after a henna application.

Mix the required quantity of Indigo Powder with lukewarm water until you get a smooth, spreadable paste. Prepare the mixture immediately before application. Apply evenly to clean, henna-prepared or appropriately prepared hair, covering the desired areas thoroughly.

Leave according to your strand-test result and desired depth of colour, then rinse thoroughly with plain water.

Allow the final shade time to settle after rinsing.

Important: Always perform a patch test and strand test before full application. Botanical colour results vary by starting hair colour and previous treatments. Pure Indigo used directly on very light or grey hair can produce unexpected cool or blue-green tones, so a henna-first routine is commonly preferred when a darker result is desired.

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, eyebrows and eyelashes.

Bring a thoughtful botanical step to wash day with NatureMist Bhringraj Powder. Its fine powder format is designed to be freshly prepared as a hair and scalp mask whenever your routine needs extra conditioning care.

Bhringraj has a long history of use in traditional Indian hair-care rituals. NatureMist keeps the experience simple: mix, apply, leave on and rinse.

Why choose NatureMist Bhringraj Powder?

  • Helps condition hair and scalp
  • Supports softer-feeling hair
  • Helps improve manageability
  • Complements pre-wash hair-mask routines
  • Freshly prepared before every application
  • Simple botanical powder format

How to use: Mix the required amount with water to create a smooth, spreadable paste. Apply evenly to damp scalp and hair. Leave for approximately 15–20 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.

For external use only. Patch test before first use. Avoid contact with eyes and discontinue use if irritation occurs.

products.title: NatureMist Hibiscus Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
A Floral Botanical Ritual for Softer-Looking Hair

Bring a vibrant botanical touch to wash day with NatureMist Hibiscus Powder. Made for conditioning-focused hair care, its fine powder format can be freshly mixed into a smooth pre-wash mask whenever your hair routine needs extra softness and care.

Hibiscus has a long tradition of use in botanical hair-care rituals. Its naturally rich floral character makes it especially suited to masks intended to leave hair feeling conditioned, smooth and refreshed.

Why choose NatureMist Hibiscus Powder?

  • Helps condition dry-feeling hair
  • Supports softer, smoother-feeling lengths
  • Helps improve everyday manageability
  • Enhances natural-looking shine
  • Ideal for a pre-wash botanical hair mask
  • Freshly mixed before each application

How to use: Mix the required amount with water to make a smooth, spreadable paste. Apply evenly to damp scalp and hair, working through the lengths. Leave for approximately 15–20 minutes, then rinse thoroughly.

For external use only. Patch test before first use. Avoid contact with eyes. Because Hibiscus naturally contains colour pigments, strand test before use on very light, bleached or highly porous hair, and avoid contact with light fabrics or surfaces.

Net Quantity: 250 g

products.title: NatureMist Shikakai Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
A Traditional Botanical Cleansing Ritual

Bring a time-honoured botanical step to wash day with NatureMist Shikakai Powder. Made from finely powdered Shikakai pods, it is traditionally used for cleansing hair and scalp.

Its naturally occurring cleansing compounds make Shikakai especially suited to powder-based wash routines. Simply mix the required amount with water, prepare a fresh paste, apply to wet hair and scalp, massage gently and rinse thoroughly.

Why choose NatureMist Shikakai Powder?

  • Helps cleanse hair and scalp
  • Helps remove excess oil and everyday buildup
  • Leaves hair feeling fresh and clean
  • Supports softer, more manageable-feeling hair
  • Suitable for botanical wash-day routines
  • Freshly mixed before every use

How to use: Mix the required quantity with water into a smooth, spreadable paste. Apply to wet scalp and hair, massage gently through the roots and lengths, then rinse thoroughly with water.

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Patch test before first use and discontinue if irritation occurs.

Net Quantity: 250 g

products.descriptionHtml:

Why choose this collection?

Three familiar botanicals in one convenient set, with each powder packed separately so you can follow its individual preparation and usage instructions. One combo purchase includes all three jars.

How to use

Follow the directions on each jar. This collection contains separate products and is not a premixed formula. Prepare a fresh mixture for each use and discard any leftover wet paste.
